_what: Does DepMap support the FET-fusion -> ATM-suppression -> ATR-axis-dependency mechanism, as a transfer prior for EMC (EWSR1/TAF15/FUS::NR4A3)?
_hypothesis_source: FET fusion oncoproteins disrupt physiologic DNA repair and create a targetable opportunity for ATR inhibitor therapy — biorxiv 10.1101/2023.04.30.538578 (PMID 37205599); clear cell sarcoma (EWSR1::ATF1) is reported to share the FET-dependent ATRi synthetic lethality, which is what makes this a CLASS claim EMC can inherit.
_instrument_ceiling: CRISPR knockout != inhibitor sensitivity. ATR is common-essential, so this scan can SUPPORT the hypothesis or miss it; it cannot refute it. Read with the module docstring's three limits.

non_FET_sarcoma._reading: BOTH_HALVES is the only tier that supports the mechanism. Any other tier is consistent with a lineage artefact and must be reported as one. NOTE the ceiling in the module docstring: a common-essential ATR compresses exactly this contrast, so a null here is NOT a refutation.

all_non_sarcoma._reading: BOTH_HALVES is the only tier that supports the mechanism. Any other tier is consistent with a lineage artefact and must be reported as one. NOTE the ceiling in the module docstring: a common-essential ATR compresses exactly this contrast, so a null here is NOT a refutation.

knockout_instrument_saturation._criterion: the ATR axis sits near the common-essential floor (~ -1 is the median common-essential gene) in EVERY group, so a between-group delta an order of magnitude under the within-group SD is an INSTRUMENT reading, not a biological one
knockout_instrument_saturation.verdict: SATURATED — the knockout read cannot address this hypothesis; use the drug-sensitivity instrument below

atr_inhibitor_sensitivity_gdsc._instrument: GDSC LN_IC50 — ATR-INHIBITOR sensitivity, not ATR knockout
atr_inhibitor_sensitivity_gdsc._sign: LN_IC50: LOWER = MORE SENSITIVE. delta_a_minus_b < 0 == FET lines more sensitive.
atr_inhibitor_sensitivity_gdsc._reading: Read the CONTROL drugs first, and quote the LINE-MEDIAN-CORRECTED contrast, never the raw one. A negative delta across ATR inhibitors AND controls alike in the RAW numbers is a growth-rate or lineage artefact, which is exactly what run 30849750035 found: talazoparib -2.34 and olaparib -1.28 against azd6738 -0.76. The corrected column removes each line's own general drug sensitivity and is what the hypothesis is actually about.

atr_inhibitor_sensitivity_depmap_attempt._instrument: ATR-INHIBITOR sensitivity (PRISM-class drug screen), NOT ATR knockout — the readout the source paper used and the one a CRISPR KO cannot give
atr_inhibitor_sensitivity_depmap_attempt._status: no PRISM/Repurposing/OncRef-looking file in the release inventory below; the inventory is recorded so the next attempt starts from fact

fet_grouping_by_fusion_call._what: FET status from DepMap's own filtered fusion calls, not from disease labels
fet_grouping_by_fusion_call._caveat: a called EWSR1/FUS/TAF15 fusion is not automatically the ONCOGENIC driver fusion — read this as a wider, noisier grouping than the label one, and use the disagreement between the two as the uncertainty, not either alone

_controls._reading: If RPL5 is not clearly essential or ATM is not near-neutral panel-wide, the read is broken and nothing else here should be quoted. ⚠ POLR2A and PRKDC are NOT in the 24Q4 column set — measured on run 30848356798, which is why the pan-essential control is RPL5.
